messages:
sam: Heads up — CI perf alert after today's merge on main. decode path p95 for short-seq workloads spiked ~38%. canary traffic was held by deploy bot. anyone on call?

devops-bot: [CI PERF] job=runtime-perf-main build=4821 status=regression p95_decode=+38% link=https://ci.internal/reports/4821 canary_hold=true

anya: ack, I'm up. can someone grab traces + kv cache metrics? i'll start a targeted bisect if we can't eyeball the change quickly.

mike: pulled the canary traces + a perf flame. Quick observation: a big chunk moved into `attn_kernel::matmul_fused` and `fuse_scheduler::schedule_batch`. KV cache hit rate for that workload dropped from ~0.60 -> 0.28 after merge. attaching short profile snippet below.

```
# perf top (sampled)
  36.2% attn_kernel::matmul_fused
  12.8% fuse_scheduler::schedule_batch
   9.5% decode_path::emit_tokens
   6.1% kv_cache::lookup
# kv cache counts (short-seq workload)
  before: hits=6023 misses=4014 ratio=0.60
  after:  hits=2134 misses=5476 ratio=0.28
```

julia: today's merge window included PRs: 8939, 8943, 8950. 8943 is the fuse-scheduler rewrite that changed microbatch ordering and introduced a new burst coalescing heuristic. doesn't surprise me.

kevin: if that's it we should revert 8943 and validate. canary is already held. mike, can you confirm with a quick toggle of the scheduler flag? we have `RUNTIME_FUSE_SCHEDULE=v1|v2` env toggle.

mike: testing toggle now. quick run with `RUNTIME_FUSE_SCHEDULE=v1` (old) on the canary image -> p95 back to baseline. bisect in progress to find exact commit.

```
# commands
git checkout main
git bisect start HEAD v0.64.2
git bisect run ./bin/perf_check --workload=shortseq --metric=p95_decode
# result
bisect log: first bad commit 0a1b2c3 -> merge PR #8943 fuse-scheduler-rewrite
```

anya: great, that pins it. i've opened a rollback PR and flagged it as rollout-blocker: https://git.internal/reverts/roll-8943. please add perf validation in the PR pipeline.

sam: Thanks. Action items: mike - validate perf on revert in CI + a small canary run; julia - coordinate the revert and release notes; kevin - hold the main deploy until revert merges; anya - update incident ticket. tagging release leads :eyes:.

devops-bot: incident created IR-2026 linked to build 4821 and PR 8943. canary_hold=true.

mike: doing a quick smoke now. initial numbers look promising; will post final numbers once CI run finishes. :thumbsup:

julia: FYI we should also add a unit/integration test to catch KV cache hit regressions for short-seq traces — adding a TODO on the revert PR.

kevin: agreed. post-mortem after this. for now revert + gated perf check is the path forward.

sam: thanks all. keeping this thread for updates — post final CI link when ready.
